Triage (finding round): promoted → `pm:queue`, type Task, S-tier mechanical — comment-only edits in `scripts/check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs` (add the fifth recognizer spelling to the three enumerations; one clause recording that a runtime-limbed `||`/`??` chain is delegated to `check:error-code-casing`, not dropped). The card's own acceptance criterion is the dispatch clause: no self-test case may move — if one does, the delegation is not what the comments claim.

Independent measurement of this from the #10716 seat (the services-lane card that renames the two codes #10658 revealed), on `origin/main` at `5f2e54cc6`. Adding it because it is a **positive control**, so the zero it produces is a real zero rather than a broken probe — the same discipline #10658 used on the casing gate.

**Probe.** Both SSO literals in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts` renamed to unregistered SCREAMING spellings (`REQUEST_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED`, `VERIFY_DOMAIN_FAILED`), each still in the `||` fallback slot:

```
node scripts/check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs   -> exit 0
  OK — 21 unregistered code-stamping site(s), all classified; 1 awaiting a ledger entry (#8846).
  scope: 1875 non-test source files under packages/; 291 registered codes; 21 found; 21 classified.
```

Baseline before the probe: **also 21**. Two unregistered codes were added and the count did not move.

**Positive control**, to separate "blind to the shape" from "file not in scan" — one DIRECT (non-fallback) unregistered code in that same file:

```
node scripts/check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs   -> exit 1
  [unclassified-site] packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts stamps unregistered
  code 'ZZ_POSITIVE_CONTROL_UNREGISTERED' (objlit) and packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-error-vocabulary.ts
  does not classify it.
  scope: … 22 unregistered code-stamping site(s) found; 21 classified.
```

The file is in scan and the gate fires on it — 21 → 22 — for the direct spelling and not for the fallback one. Both mutations were reverted; `git hash-object` confirms the file is byte-identical to its pre-probe blob (`a30734337b6aa7a60a7d8a5ec833f8b1dcbd65b1`).

**Why it was load-bearing for #10716.** That card had to choose between reusing an already-registered code and inventing a new SCREAMING spelling. This measurement closed the second door: a new spelling in the fallback slot is unregistered *and* invisible to both error-code gates, so it would have shipped as exactly the silent fourth state ADR-0112 D3 exists to prevent — a visible casing violation traded for an invisible registration one. PR #10858 reuses `DOMAIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED` (already in the ledger for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`) instead, and touches no spec file.

That also means this gap currently has no live victim in this file — after #10858 both codes there are registered. The gap itself is unchanged.
